scope: Bucket 1 backend Go Nostr trust boundary and relay subscription semantics only

criteria.statement: Backend inbound relay events are validated before persistence, deduplication, or handler dispatch.
Valid signed backend events continue through Subscriber persistence and handler dispatch.
Merged relay subscriptions expose per-relay EOSE and CLOSED metadata while preserving aggregate EOSE behavior.
Backend Subscriber and Reactor observe EOSE/CLOSED metadata and attempt AUTH/resubscribe on auth-required CLOSED where configured.
